description: One configurable input of a connector operation. Mirrors the manifest field schema: type, required-ness, expression handling, dropdown choices and conditional visibility are all data.

fields.description: Key inside connectorParams — must match what the handler reads (e.g. folder, filename).
fields.label: Field Name

fields.description: Shown to the modeler in the properties panel.
fields.label: Label
Type
fields.description: How the input is rendered in the properties panel. Use Value Transform below to normalise what the modeler types.
Panel marks the label with * (advisory — the handler still guards).
fields.label: Required

fields.description: Jinja-render the value at runtime against {doc, instance, frappe, task_data}.
fields.label: Expression
Value Transform
fields.description: Optional dotted path to a fn(value) -> value applied after the expression is rendered, e.g. one_bpmn.one_bpmn.integrations.google_common.normalize_drive_id to accept either a Google share link or a bare id.
One choice per line as Label|value (or just value). Ignored when Choices From is set.
fields.label: Choices
Choices From (dotted path)
fields.description: Dotted path to a fn(**context) -> [{label, value}] called to populate this dropdown live. Sibling field values are passed as keyword arguments, so a function taking folder receives the folder field's current value. Overrides the static Choices above.
Show this field only when another field matches. Use the literal operation to test the selected operation.
fields.label: Only Show When Field
